findings.description: Rounding logic incorrectly rounds half-cent ties down. The spec requires ties (remainder == 5) to round upward, but the implementation uses (remainder > 5).
findings.evidence: For input 15 (15 mills = 1.5 cents), candidate.cents(15) returns 1, but should return 2 per the "exact half-cent ties rounded upward" rule.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to round half-cent ties upward, violating the rounding specification.
